attr.title: Summertime Saga
attr.desc: Universal AArch64 port of the free Summertime Saga Android Preview through a native Ren'Py compatibility loader. Supports current NextOS and GLIBC 2.30-class ArkOS/R36S systems, controller pointer, audio, saves and clean exit. Adult content; BYO-data, game files are not included.
attr.inst: For adults only. Place the official free Android Preview APK or bundle in summertimesaga/gamedata and launch the port. NXExtract validates and prepares compatible current or future 21.x/8.5.x builds automatically.
